$note: Source of every Blanc-authored interface string. Edit here, translate in the same PR, run copy:ack for the keys you translated, then copy:build.

settings.language.label.note: Settings → General row label and the language menu's accessible name.

settings.language.hint.note: Disclosure under the language menu; translations are AI-generated without human review.

settings.language.system.note: Menu option that follows the OS language; {language} is the endonym it currently resolves to, e.g. Deutsch.

settings.language.relaunch.note: Button that restarts Blanc so a new interface language takes effect.

key.ctrl.note: Name of the Control key in shortcut hints on Windows and Linux (German keyboards print Strg).

key.shift.note: Name of the Shift key in shortcut hints on Windows and Linux (German keyboards print Umschalt).

app.title.note: Window title of the browser chrome.

menu.main.title.note: Tooltip of the main-menu button on Windows and Linux; Alt+F is its shortcut.

menu.main.label.note: Accessible name of the main-menu button on Windows and Linux.

pill.title.note: Tooltip of the resting Island pill; Ctrl/Cmd+L opens it.

pill.insecure.title.message: Not secure — this site uses an unencrypted connection (HTTP)
pill.insecure.title.note: Default tooltip of the pill's not-secure badge.

pill.insecure.label.message: Not secure — this site uses an unencrypted connection. Open site controls.
pill.insecure.label.note: Default accessible name of the pill's not-secure badge (a button that opens site controls).

pill.insecure.fallback.note: Not-secure badge tooltip when main sends no specific reason.

pill.insecure.open.note: Accessible name of the not-secure badge; {title} is the security warning shown as its tooltip.

pill.domainDefault.note: Initial lowercase label in the pill before the first tab state arrives.

pill.placeholder.note: Pill label on a blank new tab, inviting the user to open the command bar.

pill.commands.note: Tooltip and accessible name of the pill's slash button that opens commands.

pill.private.chip.note: Lowercase chip in the pill on a private tab; clicking it closes the tab.

pill.private.title.message: Leave private mode — closes this tab

pill.source.chip.note: Lowercase chip in the pill on a view-source tab; clicking it closes the tab.

pill.fillHint.note: Tooltip and accessible name of the 1Password fill chip; {shortcut} is ⌥⌘P on macOS or Ctrl+Shift+P on Windows and Linux.

pill.back.note: Pill button: go back in this tab's history.

pill.forward.note: Pill button: go forward in this tab's history.

pill.newTab.title.note: Tooltip of the pill's new-tab button; {shortcut} is ⌘T or Ctrl+T.

pill.stop.note: Pill button while a page loads: stop loading.

pill.favorite.note: Pill heart button when the page is not a favorite.

pill.unfavorite.note: Pill heart button when the page is already a favorite.

pill.closeTab.note: Pill button that closes the active tab.

pill.downloads.note: Pill downloads button; opens the Downloads sheet.

pill.downloading.note: Downloads button tooltip while downloads run; # is the number of active downloads.

pill.downloadDone.note: Downloads button tooltip right after a download finishes.

pill.moreTabs.message: {count, plural, one {# more tab — open the list} other {# more tabs — open the list}}
pill.moreTabs.note: Tooltip of the +N overflow beside the pill's tab dots; opens the tab list.

dot.switchTo.note: Accessible name of a tab dot or rail row; {title} is the tab's title.

capture.both.message: camera & microphone in use — open capture controls
capture.both.note: Capture chip tooltip while a page uses camera and microphone.

capture.camera.message: camera in use — open capture controls
capture.camera.note: Capture chip tooltip while a page uses the camera.

capture.microphone.message: microphone in use — open capture controls
capture.microphone.note: Capture chip tooltip while a page uses the microphone.

share.choosing.message: Choosing what to share — open share controls
share.choosing.note: Screen-share chip tooltip while the share picker is open.

share.sharing.note: Screen-share chip tooltip; {surface} names the shared window or screen.

share.sharingScreen.message: Sharing this screen — open share controls
share.sharingScreen.note: Screen-share chip tooltip when the shared surface has no name.

share.count.message: {count, plural, one {# screen share — open share controls} other {# screen shares — open share controls}}
share.count.note: Screen-share chip tooltip with several shares in this window.

window.minimize.note: Window control button on Windows and Linux.

window.maximize.note: Window control button on Windows and Linux.

window.close.note: Window control button on Windows and Linux.

tab.loading.note: Shown while a tab loads and has no title yet.

tab.new.note: Label for opening a new tab (rail button, accessible names).

tab.untitled.note: Fallback title of a tab that has none yet.

tab.untitledPrivate.note: Fallback title of a private tab that has none yet.

tab.privateLabel.note: Glance header label for a private tab that has no title yet.

glance.eyebrow.note: Uppercase eyebrow of the Glance reference-pane header. Glance is a fixed product name.

glance.promote.note: Tooltip and accessible name of the button that swaps Glance with the main page.

glance.promoteShort.note: Short visible label of that same button.

glance.change.note: Button that picks a different tab for Glance.

glance.change.title.message: Choose a different tab for Glance

glance.close.note: Tooltip and accessible name of the Glance close button.

glance.resize.note: Accessible name of the divider between the main page and Glance.

glance.dividerValue.note: Screen-reader value of the Glance divider; {percent} is the main page's share of the width.

resize.hint.message: Drag to resize; double-click to reset
resize.hint.note: Tooltip of resize handles (Glance divider, vertical tabs edge).

rail.label.note: Accessible name of the vertical tabs rail.

rail.islandLayout.note: Rail toolbar button that returns to the Island layout.

rail.list.note: Accessible name of the rail's tab list.

rail.resize.note: Accessible name of the rail's resize handle.

rail.widthValue.note: Screen-reader value of the rail's resize handle; {width} is the rail width.

rail.widthReset.message: Vertical tabs width reset to {width} pixels
rail.widthReset.note: Announced after resetting the rail width.

rail.tab.current.note: Accessible name of the rail row for the active tab.

rail.tab.withStates.note: Rail row accessible name followed by its comma-separated states.

rail.state.active.note: Rail row state read by screen readers.

rail.state.private.note: Rail row state read by screen readers.

rail.state.pinned.note: Rail row state read by screen readers.

rail.state.loading.note: Rail row state read by screen readers.

rail.state.quiet.note: Rail row state read by screen readers (a Quiet Tab).

rail.state.muted.note: Rail row state read by screen readers.

rail.state.playingAudio.note: Rail row state read by screen readers.

rail.marker.pinned.note: Tooltip of the rail row's pin marker.

rail.marker.muted.note: Tooltip of the rail row's muted marker.

rail.marker.playingAudio.note: Tooltip of the rail row's audio marker.

rail.close.note: Tooltip and accessible name of a rail row's close button.

rail.group.containsCurrent.note: Tooltip of the marker on a collapsed group holding the active tab.

rail.move.top.note: Announced when a keyboard move cannot go further up.

rail.move.bottom.note: Announced when a keyboard move cannot go further down.

drag.movedGroup.note: Announced after moving a tab group; {group} is its name.

drag.movedTab.note: Announced after reordering a tab; {title} is its title.

drag.movedTabUntitled.note: Announced after reordering a tab that has no title.

drag.movedTo.note: Announced after moving a tab into a group.

drag.movedOutOf.note: Announced after moving a tab out of a group.

drag.movedToRemoved.note: Announced when moving a tab into {group} empties and removes group {from}.

drag.movedOutOfRemoved.note: Announced when moving the last tab out of group {from} removes it.

drag.failed.note: Announced when a drag-and-drop move fails; {title} is the tab title or group name.

drag.failedTab.note: Announced when moving an untitled tab fails.

drag.failedGroup.note: Announced when moving an unnamed group fails.

rail.group.label.note: Accessible name of a rail group header; {name} is the group name, {state} is collapsed or expanded.

rail.group.labelWithCurrent.message: {name}, {count, plural, one {# tab} other {# tabs}}, {state}, contains current tab
rail.group.labelWithCurrent.note: Accessible name of a rail group header that holds the active tab.

rail.group.collapsed.note: Rail group state read by screen readers.

rail.group.expanded.note: Rail group state read by screen readers.

rail.private.marker.note: Lowercase marker on a private tab's rail row.

rail.section.pinned.note: Lowercase heading of the rail section holding pinned tabs that are not in a group.

rail.section.tabs.note: Lowercase heading of the rail section holding ungrouped tabs.

permission.surfaceTitle.note: Title of the hidden document that hosts site permission prompts.

permission.label.note: Accessible name of the permission prompt bar.

permission.allow.note: Button that grants the site's permission request.

permission.block.note: Button that denies the site's permission request.

permission.prompt.cameraMicrophone.message: <0>{host}</0> wants to use your camera and microphone
permission.prompt.cameraMicrophone.note: Permission prompt; <0>{host}</0> is the requesting site's host, possibly shortened from the start.

permission.prompt.camera.note: Permission prompt; <0>{host}</0> is the requesting site's host.

permission.prompt.microphone.note: Permission prompt; <0>{host}</0> is the requesting site's host.

permission.prompt.geolocation.note: Permission prompt; <0>{host}</0> is the requesting site's host.

permission.prompt.notifications.note: Permission prompt; <0>{host}</0> is the requesting site's host.

permission.prompt.other.note: Permission prompt for another permission; {permission} is Chromium's permission name.

fill.surfaceTitle.note: Title of the hidden document that hosts the 1Password fill capsule.

fill.dismiss.note: Accessible name of the fill notice's close button.

dialog.ok.note: Single button of an informational native dialog.

fill.setupEnable.title.note: Fill capsule title when 1Password fill is turned off in Settings.

fill.setupEnable.body.message: Turn on “Fill logins from 1Password” in Settings. Blanc only reads a matching login when you ask.
fill.setupEnable.body.note: Fill capsule body; the quoted text is the Settings toggle's label and must match it exactly.

fill.setupEnable.primaryLabel.note: Fill capsule button that opens Settings.

fill.setupAccount.title.note: Fill capsule title when no 1Password account email is configured.

fill.setupAccount.body.message: Add the email address you sign in to 1Password with, in Settings.

fill.setupAccount.primaryLabel.note: Fill capsule button that opens Settings.

fill.confirmHeuristic.title.note: Fill capsule question when the page did not clearly mark its password field.

fill.confirmHeuristic.body.message: This page didn’t clearly mark its password field. Blanc re-checks the exact fields before filling.

fill.confirmHeuristic.primaryLabel.note: Fill capsule button that fills the login.

fill.busy.body.message: Finish or cancel the current request first.

fill.unsupportedPage.title.note: Fill notice title on a page that is not HTTP or HTTPS.

fill.unsupportedPage.body.message: 1Password fill works on HTTP and HTTPS pages.

fill.pageChanged.body.message: Nothing was filled. Return to the login form and try again.

fill.noForm.body.message: Blanc couldn’t find a safe username or password field here.

fill.noMatch.body.message: 1Password has no Login item saved for this site.
fill.noMatch.body.note: Fill notice body; "Login item" is 1Password's item type.

fill.emptyLogin.body.message: The selected item has no username or password value.

fill.nothingFilled.body.message: The selected login had no value for the fields Blanc found.

fill.unexpected.body.message: Nothing was filled. Try again from the login form.

fill.desktopUnavailable.body.message: Open the 1Password app and turn on Settings → Developer → Integrate with 1Password SDKs.
fill.desktopUnavailable.body.note: Fill notice body; the arrow path names 1Password's own settings, which the user sees in 1Password's language.

fill.accountNotFound.body.message: Check your 1Password email address in Blanc Settings, then try again.

fill.notAuthorized.body.message: Unlock 1Password and approve Blanc Browser, then try again.
fill.notAuthorized.body.note: Fill notice body; "Blanc Browser" is the app name 1Password shows in its approval prompt.

fill.sessionExpired.body.message: Try again to authorize a fresh session.

fill.timedOut.body.message: Nothing was filled. Try again when 1Password is ready.

fill.sdkError.body.message: Nothing was filled. Check 1Password and try again.

fill.selectionChanged.body.message: The item changed while the list was open. Nothing was filled.
